name: Ollama
launch: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH={context} OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0 ollama serve   # then: ollama pull {model}
native_tools: The model's Ollama template must include tools (ollama show --template {model}); crit uses the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (url http://127.0.0.1:11434).
kv_cache: OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE f16 (default) or q8_0 (needs OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1); avoid q4_0.
cache: keep_alive keeps the model loaded; Ollama's default 2048/4096-token context is too small for an agent: set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.
notes: Environment variable names are from Ollama releases of 2025; older ones need num_ctx in a Modelfile instead of OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.
